evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive issued from positional authority establishing a mandatory recurring cadence — declarative command, not a request.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Maxim-style logical argument that reframes unrehearsed rollback as no rollback at all — rational persuasion fused with insistence.
Animator ratifies and records the authority's directive as an institutional fact — legitimate power enacted through documentation.
Animator assigns ownership to the authority figure, ratifying positional power through formal attribution.
